title: Meta signs multi-billion-dollar deal to rent Google AI chips, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 签署了数十亿美元的租赁谷歌人工智能芯片协议
summary: Meta Platforms has signed a multi-billion dollar deal to rent artificial intelligence chips ‌from Google to develop new AI models, The ‌Information reported on Thursday, citing a person involved in the talks.
summary_zh: 据 The Information 周四援引一位参与谈判的人士的话报道，Meta Platforms 已签署一项价值数十亿美元的协议，从谷歌租赁人工智能芯片来开发新的人工智能模型。

title: Oracle Red Bull Racing Deal Puts AI Cloud Story In Spotlight
title_zh: Oracle Red Bull Racing 交易让 AI 云故事成为焦点
summary: Oracle and Oracle Red Bull Racing agreed a major multi year extension and expansion of their title partnership around Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and AI.
summary_zh: 甲骨文和甲骨文红牛车队就甲骨文云基础设施和人工智能方面的冠军合作关系进行了为期多年的重大延期和扩展。

title: Morgan Stanley 'Absolutely' Plans to Offer Bitcoin Custody, Trading, Yield and Lending: Exec
title_zh: 摩根士丹利“绝对”计划提供比特币托管、交易、收益和贷款：执行官
summary: Morgan Stanley wants to let clients custody and trade Bitcoin—and it's building the tech itself.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利希望让客户托管和交易比特币，并且它正在自行开发这项技术。

title: Private Credit’s Great Divide: Imminent Crisis or ‘No Big Deal’
title_zh: 私人信贷的巨大分歧：危机迫在眉睫还是“没什么大不了的”
summary: To the likes of Jamie Dimon, Mohamed El-Erian and even a money manager from , the parallels with the run-up to the 2008 financial crisis are obvious.
summary_zh: 对于杰米·戴蒙 (Jamie Dimon)、穆罕默德·埃里安 (Mohamed El-Erian) 甚至是来自 2008 年金融危机前夕的资金经理来说，这种情况的相似之处是显而易见的。

title: Market Chatter: Kuwait Petroleum Held Talks With Investors Over Potential $7 Billion Pipeline Deal
title_zh: 市场热议：科威特石油公司与投资者就潜在的 70 亿美元管道交易进行会谈
summary: Kuwait Petroleum had early talks with investors like BlackRock (BLK), KKR (KKR), EIG Partners, and B
summary_zh: 科威特石油公司与 BlackRock (BLK)、KKR (KKR)、EIG Partners 和 B 等投资者进行了早期谈判
